bullish.$description: Chart-specific up/bullish color. Same hex as color.success but a distinct semantic token — chart code must not depend on the status palette.

bearish.$description: Chart-specific down/bearish color. Same hex as color.error but a distinct semantic token.

fng.$description: Fear & Greed index band colors. Source: components/ui/constants/fngConstants.ts FNG_LEVEL_COLORS. Mode-invariant.

indicator.$description: Base 3-band indicator tones (fear/neutral/greed) shared by FearGreedWidget, WidgetOverrideSettings and indicator-info for mid-range tones; extremes come from color.success/color.error. Genuinely distinct hex values from color.chart.fng.* — not the same palette. Source: fngConstants.ts INDICATOR_COLORS.

fear.$description: Literally #F7931A — same value as color.primitive.bitcoin, aliased per the no-duplicate-literal rule.

ema.$description: Named EMA overlay line palette. Source: constants/crypto.ts EMA_COLORS (12 named colors, reused by chart embeds, HLine/icon/cycle overlays).

orange.$description: Literally #F7931A — same value as color.primitive.bitcoin, aliased per the no-duplicate-literal rule.

emaPeriod.$description: Canonical weekly EMA period -> color mapping. Source: constants/crypto.ts EMA_PERIOD_DEFAULT_COLOR (also duplicated verbatim in the dashboard's chartEmbedSyntax.js). Each entry is literally the same data as color.chart.ema.* keyed by period number instead of color name, so every entry aliases 1:1 into color.chart.ema.*.
